scope: AI source-visual development review of B2; not independent human ground truth, holdout evaluation, physical cork/floor measurement, or IN/OUT qualification.
verdict: Useful corrected first-bounce approximation supported by actual source object motion, not coordinate proximity alone.
source_observations: Sequential native frames39–45 show the same main-shuttle terminal descent; frames36–38 are partly obscured by the foreground white-shirt player.
Frames42–45 clearly descend to the low point near45; the visible racket is separated from this turn point. There is no source-supported earlier racket turn on this inspected terminal segment.
The actual cork/plume rises in46–52 and drops again by53. Model-only46/47/49–51 follows that moving object.
A separate stationary white floor feature is already visible before contact near the moving trajectory; the lossless detail sequence distinguishes it from the rebounding shuttle.

fusion_association_caveat.finding: The CV fusion sample is on the stationary white floor feature; the model-only sample follows the rising shuttle. Fusion returns to the moving shuttle by48. Thus the ensemble primary is useful, but not every selected observation has verified same-object identity.

adapter_provenance.inference_input: Full development clip, four fixed unhinted overlapping tiles, batches of8 actual source frames plus full-clip median background; no reference coordinates/event windows enter inference or selection.
adapter_provenance.padding: Final batch repeats last real frame for input padding; only outputs for real frame indices are retained.
adapter_provenance.coordinate_kind: Image-conditioned learned heatmap-component box centre, with raw-image contrast support nearby. It is not a directly measured native cork centre.
adapter_provenance.appearance_limitation: Source-patch radius/polarity may describe a nearby background/occluder component (notably broad dark support at48). A supported patch does not independently establish shuttle identity.
adapter_provenance.occluder_metadata_limitation: Learned proposals retain unknown per-observation possible_occluder_overlap; retained record-level occlusion regions do not by themselves label each model sample.
adapter_provenance.upstream_original_checkpoint_identity: The recorded mirror/model hash is reproducible; upstream-original checkpoint bit identity is not independently verified.

source_evidence.decode: Sequential original3840x2160 ffmpeg decode, exact zero-based frame selection36–53, threads2, native300x260 crop without resize; enlarged detail uses nearest-neighbor only.

release_scope: Research evidence only. No ML weights bundle is recommended for the current CV release based on this limited development result; broader controls/generalization remain necessary.
